definition: a scientist who spends life on research
description: A research camp on a sunny snowfield. A young woman scientist in a red down jacket and gloves holds up a long clear cylinder of ice from a drill and studies it, her breath steaming. A bearded man in a red jacket and dark hat steps in beside her and points at the ice, and she smiles. Beside them stands a metal drill rig, and other men in red jackets and orange snow trousers look on. Boxes of ice samples sit on a wooden sledge with coiled rope, and red tents, flags and jagged mountains are behind them.

taps.phrase: to hold up an ice core

taps.target: the man in the dark hat
